title: Unique Spicy Mexican Sugar Snap Peas Pozole
description: A festive Mexican dish featuring sugar snap peas, char-grill flavors, and halal-friendly ingredients, all in a delicious pozole form. This recipe combines the sweetness of sugar snap peas with the spiciness of Mexican flavors.
instructions: Roast the hominy in a 400 degree oven for 10 minutes to enhance its flavor.
Char the onion and garlic in a large pot over medium heat until they are lightly browned.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper to the pot and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, roasted hominy, sugar snap peas, salt, and pepper to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the pozole for 20 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Stir in the lime juice and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the pozole hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Offer tortilla chips or crusty bread on the side for a fun textural contrast.
Consider adding other toppings such as diced radishes, shredded lettuce, or diced avocado to make the dish more substantial.
